verdict.rationale: Martin is a personal AI assistant, so cross-conversation memory is a fair axis. The evidence pack never documents the assistant remembering prior chats and applying that context automatically in new conversations. The closest features are user-commanded notes (e.g., "Note down everything we talked about on this call") and to-dos reachable from any interface. These are explicit, user-managed storage, an adjacent feature rather than conversational memory, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations
